title: One unknown insights metric voids the whole Graph insights call
symptoms: The entire insights request fails because one metric name is invalid
A whole platform's posts drop out of a report after a metric is renamed
cause: When the metric list contains a name the API version does not recognize, the call fails as a whole rather than skipping that metric.
fix: Request metrics one at a time, or retry without the failing metric, and keep whatever answers.
apply: for m in metrics: GET /{object-id}/insights?metric={m}; keep successes, log the failures
